description: DELETE, without force, the default screen of the module (tested coverage, phase 2). The reactive-ui has no DefaultScreen, so the first screen created headless takes that role and the module itself starts to cite it. The delete used to refuse with a consumer with an empty path (the ESpace); the Studio deletes and leaves only the warning 'Unknown Default Screen'. Now the DefaultScreen does not refuse: the usages shows the IESpace with derived true and path 'IESpace:<module>'. The warning stays on the ESpace, in a one-level path that expectedMessages does not declare, so the job picks the new default screen right afterwards and Verify has no new messages.

ops._why: count 1, real 0: o IESpace (DefaultScreen), derived true
without this, the warning InvalidOptionalPropertyValue_PropertyIn_WithPrevious ('Unknown Default Screen') stays on the ESpace
